name: Constrained Jacobi Smoothing for SDFs
aliases: Constrained Jacobi Smoothing for Signed Distance Functions
definition: A technique to convert a binary volume into a smooth signed distance function (SDF) by minimizing an energy functional using Jacobi iteration, subject to constraints that preserve the binary topology.
summary: Constrained Jacobi Smoothing converts binary volumes to signed distance functions while guaranteeing exact topological preservation, unlike Gaussian smoothing which may alter topology.
